flagship_project.name: Project SwarmPulse: Autonomous Hyperlocal Demand Prediction, Micro-Fulfillment Swarm Engine & 8-Minute Drone-Ground Routing Mesh
flagship_project.pillar: Autonomous Hyperlocal Logistics & Micro-Darkstore Swarm Engine
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Instamart and food delivery unit economics hinge on batching efficiency and sub-10 minute delivery. SwarmPulse unifies dark-store automated picking robots, predictive rider dispatch (dispatching before the customer checkout completes), and dynamic surge pricing on a sub-50ms geospatial hexagonal grid.
flagship_project.tech_stack: C++ / Rust (H3 Hexagonal Geohash Indexer), Go (Dispatch Daemon), Redpanda (High-Throughput Streaming), Apache Flink (Real-time Stream Processing), CockroachDB (Globally Resilient Metadata), Python PyTorch (On-device/Edge Demand Forecaster)
flagship_project.kpis: Sub-8 minute average Instamart delivery in dense clusters; 31% increase in multi-order rider batching; zero dark-store stockouts on high-velocity SKUs.
